rationale: This mutation closes the cash deficit by synchronizing progressive plot expansion (6–8 plots at 3 hands, 10–12 at 5 hands, and a strict 16-plot ceiling by Day 13 at 8+ hands) with Strawberry Acreage Sovereignty, unlocking massive multi-harvest compounding without labor idle time. It repairs farm execution by keeping in-situ watering immediately following cluster harvesting before shed transit to eliminate dry-plot growth halts, while integrating fertilizer retrieval and application directly after harvest drop-offs. Finally, it eliminates stranded late-game capital via strict shop seed phase-gates (banning Pumpkins after Day 16, Tomatoes after Day 21, Carrots after Day 25) and enforces a velocity-preserving liquidation policy (>=0.82x Days 1–8, >=0.86x Days 9–28, terminal Day 29–30 sweep) alongside a zero-animal wheat reserve purge.
